theme: An open day with the overdue decisions finally in reach.
greeting: The day is almost entirely yours, Dan — one dinner out tonight and nothing else on the calendar. It's the opening to close out the travel decisions that slipped past their dates, and to get ready for tomorrow's call with Pema.

needsAttention.title: Prep for the Pema call at Sun Life
needsAttention.detail: Pema, Sun Life's director of sustainability outreach, connected on LinkedIn and is on your calendar tomorrow at 2:30 PM; arrive with two or three points tying her mandate to your sustainability-reporting work.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Your own decide-by date was Sept 30 and the book-by is Oct 15; the plan calls for a domestic shortlist, since the kids' passports won't be in hand by booking day.

needsAttention.title: Hold a Christmas SUV in Portland
needsAttention.detail: The p1 task to book a refundable full-size SUV out of PWM for Christmas week is overdue — holiday inventory is thin and sells out, so a refundable hold now costs nothing and removes the risk.

needsAttention.title: Set up the Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5-18 window to drive Portland to St Pete opens in four days; the hotel night and where the car sits each month still need settling.

flagged.title: Public affairs director role at Servier
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn job alert flagged a Sr. Director, U.S. Public Affairs opening posted yesterday.

flagged.title: LinkedIn message from Hans-Kristian
flagged.detail: A new LinkedIn message is waiting on a reply — worth a look given your active networking.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters and retail — Delta, Bloomberg, NYT Cooking, and a stack of travel and shopping promos.
inbox.clear: No email needs a reply from you today.

recipe.title: Mushroom Ragoût
recipe.why: Autumn is peak mushroom season, and a slow ragoût makes the most of their earthy depth.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike

acts.line: A clear morning with nothing scheduled — the first real opening to close out the overdue travel decisions.
The afternoon stays open; the only thing on the near horizon is tomorrow's 2:30 call with Pema.
The evening brings a dinner out, and the rest of the day is yours to steer.
